lines.zh: 我一步一沉，骨头都在响。
lines.en: Each step lands heavy and my bones rattle.

lines.zh: 我整个骨架撑起身体走。
lines.en: I walk on nothing but my skeleton.
My head hangs low and my spine arches.

lines.zh: 我从林子中间撞开一条路。
lines.en: I crash a path through the wood.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴骨拖着，划出长痕。
lines.en: My tailbone drags a long line.
My foot comes down and the ground dents.
Turning costs me a lot of effort.
My bone claws rake the stone.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边发出低响。
lines.en: I make a low sound as I walk.

lines.zh: 我停下来，又往前压一步。
lines.en: I stop, then press one step on.
I follow a scent.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方连草都不剩。
lines.en: Nothing green is left where I pass.

lines.zh: 我站着，骨节在轻轻摩擦。
lines.en: I stand and my joints grind faintly.
My spine rises in segments.
I've no hide, only bone.
My lower jaw hangs open.
I listen — I hear a long way.
My shadow is bigger than I am.
My skull turns slowly.

lines.zh: 风从我的肋骨之间穿过去。
lines.en: Wind passes through my ribs.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一具骨架。
lines.en: Still as I am, I'm just a skeleton.
There are old breaks in my bones.
I close my jaw slowly.

lines.zh: 地上有我骨头刮出的痕。
lines.en: There are grooves on the ground from my bones.

lines.zh: 我没有呼吸，只有骨头响。
lines.en: I don't breathe. Only bones rattle.
I am waiting for something.
You are far too small for me.

lines.zh: 我低下头，骨头卡卡地响。
lines.en: I lower my head and the bones clack.
I have never needed speed.
You stepped back; my bones still come on.
I open my jaw.
There are gaps between my ribs.
I smell you from far off.
I raise a bone claw, joints creaking.

lines.zh: 你身上没有骨头的味道。
lines.en: You don't smell of bone.

lines.zh: 我张开下颚，骨头咔咔响。
lines.en: I open my jaw and the bones clack.
No hurry; take your time.
My bone claws are open.
Your shadow falls on my ribs.

lines.zh: 我整体的骨头响了一下。
lines.en: My whole frame clatters.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了一根肋骨。
lines.en: That snapped a rib.
I give half a step and a joint catches.
Bone dust falls off me.

lines.zh: 我低下头发出一声闷响。
lines.en: I lower my head with a hollow sound.
One of my hands rests on the ground.
I straighten my body up again.
I remember where you stood.
Pain only makes a sound. I don't gasp.
That smell makes my jaw ache.
Walking that way, bones clacking.
That won't fill my jaw.

lines.zh: 我在恶地很久没吃到东西。
lines.en: I haven't eaten in the badlands in a long while.
Set it down and I won't come for you.
The smell of blood fills my hollow chest.
My jaw has opened on its own.
And I am still very hungry.
That smell stirs something old.

lines.zh: 咽下去，什么感觉也没有。
lines.en: I swallow, and feel nothing at all.
You have that smell on you too.

lines.zh: 你撞在我骨架上，退了很远。
lines.en: You hit my frame and go back a long way.
None of my bones shifted.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我一根肋骨响了。
lines.en: That made one of my ribs sound.

lines.zh: 你撞到我腿上就弹开了。
lines.en: You hit my leg and bounced off.
I move my foot aside a little.
You're softer than bone.
I heard you.
I stop dead and wait for you to clear.
There's no other skeleton here.
I can't remember before.
I remember something heavy.

lines.zh: 我记得自己曾经叫过别的名字。
lines.en: I remember a different name.

lines.zh: 我的下颚动了动，没有声音。
lines.en: My jaw moves and makes no sound.
I stand on this badland.
Wind turns circles in my hollow ribs.
The bones keep creaking.
I pick up a bone.
It crumbles between my teeth.
It's not enough to fill one bone gap.
I kick it over by the rocks.
I pin it with a bone claw.
No flesh on these bone hands.
My bones roll over it and it's dust.
This piece of meat barely fills a tooth gap.
My eye sockets have locked onto you.
My jaw opens with a clack.
My eye sockets fix on it.
One step and you've nowhere to go.
It backed off; I keep walking.
I've closed every way out.
It's climbing a tree.
I strike the tree.
It is already shaking.
I grind toward it, step by step.
It's fast; I'm steady.
I do not stop at all.
That rock won't stop my knee.
I push the rock aside.
It keeps on running.
I can follow its line.
It's run into a corner.
Its breath is heaving.
Only a few steps between us.
That one was all bone.
My knee pins it; it can't get free.
My jaw closed.
It's knocked to the ground.
My ribs shuddered.
It tore free and ran.
My tailbone sweeps up gravel.

lines.zh: 我的骨拳落下去，尘都起了。
lines.en: My bone fist comes down and dust rises.
It crumples into the gravel.
The second time, my whole frame bears down.
The red dirt splits and I push my frame up.
Bone by bone, I come together.
The first sound is my bones.
Red badland all around.
I look down at this skeletal frame.
No hide, no flesh.
My jaw opens slowly.
When I move, every joint sounds.

lines.zh: 我的骨头全露在外面，反而更硬。
lines.en: My bones are bare, and harder for it.
A bird flies off in the distance.
My bones sound with every step.

lines.zh: 火在我骨头上烧，发着响。
lines.en: Fire burns on my bones with a crackle.

lines.zh: 我砸到地上，骨头散了几块。
lines.en: I hit the ground and a few bones come loose.
Water can't get in, but it weighs me down.
The blast flips my whole frame.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在我两根骨头之间。
lines.en: An arrow lodges between two of my bones.
My bones are moving on their own.
So hungry even my bones feel light.

lines.zh: 雷穿过我的骨架，全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning runs through my frame and lights it up.
I fall, and fall.
